topic.label: Claude Code Reference
topic.desc: Claude Code Reference: CLI, commands and settings, Tools, hooks and channels, Sessions and interaction, Glossary.

concepts: CLI, commands and settings: CLI reference, Commands, Environment variables.
Tools, hooks and channels: Tools reference, Hooks reference, Channels reference.
Sessions and interaction: Interactive mode, Checkpointing.
skills: Reference for the Claude Code command-line interface, including commands and flags.
Reference for commands available in Claude Code, including built-in commands and bundled skills.
Reference for environment variables that control Claude Code behavior.
Reference for the tools Claude Code can use, including permission requirements and per-tool behavior.
Reference for Claude Code hook events, configuration schema, JSON input/output formats, exit codes, async hooks, HTTP hooks, prompt hooks, and MCP tool hooks.

Build an MCP server that pushes webhooks, alerts, and chat messages into a Claude Code session. Reference for the channel contract: capability declaration, notification events, reply tools, sender gating, and permission relay.
Reference for keyboard shortcuts, input modes, and interactive features in Claude Code sessions.
Track, rewind, and summarize Claude's edits and conversation to manage session state.
Definitions for Claude Code terminology. Learn what agentic loop, compaction, CLAUDE.md, hooks, subagents, MCP, and other core concepts mean.

provenance.basis: Human0's claude_domain.csv (sha256 d26d41d8da4ed7dd622b6e6faa18a97dc91d4f3d2af972ae9715d41ee94963cc), converted by tools/claude_domain/build_claude_packs.py on 2026-11-27. Topics, concepts, skills (docs pages) and agent names are Human0's. A single-page skill's description is that page's own one-line description where the site publishes one (page_descriptions.json: llms.txt / llms-full.txt fetched 2026-11-27); concept descriptions, other skill descriptions, keywords, skill types (a verb rule), ids and the lexicon are generated from the CSV text.
provenance.mcp_notes: Human0's CSV lists 'Claude Developer Platform docs' for this topic, but that server (Claude Platform Docs, directory cc6f3470-080c-45b8-84e1-cdc03e9c6ac1) covers platform.claude.com only, by its own instructions, and a search for 'Claude Code hooks' on 2026-11-27 returned only platform.claude.com pages. No MCP server for these docs was verified, so the pack lists none.
provenance.limitations: Skills without a published page description (API reference endpoints and some guides) are described by their titles only; skill types come from the first word of the title. Docs pages change: the URLs were current in the CSV, not re-checked here.
